readmeMarkdown: # Factdock MCP server Factdock is a multilingual search engine for primary sources. It searches the web of the country you choose in that country's own language, and returns the original pages (official sites, academic papers, patent publications, company registries, medicine databases) with translated titles and summaries and their source URLs. - **Endpoint:** `https://fact-dock.com/mcp` (remote, Streamable HTTP) - **Sign-in:** OAuth 2.1 (dynamic client registration + PKCE), or a personal API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer fdu_...` - **Account:** a Factdock account on a paid plan. Paid tools use the account's Factdock credits at the same price as in the Factdock app. The free `get_prices` tool lists current prices, and every result returns `credits_used`. - **Nothing to install:** this repository only holds connection settings. The server runs at fact-dock.com. ## Tools | Area | Tools | |---|---| | Web search by country or language sphere | `web_search` | | Academic papers | `academic_search` | | Medical & veterinary literature | `medical_literature_search` | | Patents | `patent_search`, `patent_detail` | | Companies (registry, sanctions, risk) | `company_identify`, `company_report` | | Trade compliance (HS codes, tariffs, export controls) | `trade_compliance_check`, `sourcing_search` | | Economy and finance statistics | `finance_search` | | Real estate | `realestate_market`, `realestate_registry` | | Government and infrastructure projects | `gov_infra_search` | | Laws (official text of an article) | `statute_search` | | Contracts | `contract_review`, `contract_bilingual_compare`, `contract_draft_outline`, `contract_draft_generate` | | Medicine databases | `medical_db_search`, `medical_db_detail` | | Veterinary references | `vet_drug_risk_check`, `vet_intake_crosscheck`, `clinical_fact_search`, `clinical_hypothesis_search`, `clinical_web_context` | | Infectious disease map | `epidemic_diseases`, `epidemic_risk` | | Global Insights news feed | `insights_feed`, `insights_videos` | | Documents from results (Word, PDF or Markdown, using your templates) | `list_doc_templates`, `create_work_document` (free) | | Share link for results | `create_share_link` (free) | | Prices | `get_prices` (free) | | Receive a result that did not arrive | `get_pending_result` (free) | The full tool list with descriptions is published at . **Supported coverage is in the tool schemas.** Where a tool works only for certain countries, the input field lists them, so your AI assistant can see the coverage before calling: `realestate_registry` (20 countries), `sourcing_search` (132 countries). Official tariff rates cover the US, GB, JP, NZ, TW, NO, BR, MX, CA, VN, UA, AE, CL, UY, ZA, AU, KR, TR, CN, the EAEU members (RU, KZ, BY, AM, KG) and the 27 EU member states. The descriptions of `trade_compliance_check` and `epidemic_risk` list which tariff tables and diseases are covered. A country outside the list is refused before any credits are used. **Medical and veterinary literature (`medical_literature_search`):** searches Europe PMC, PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov (all three by default, or the ones you choose). For a clinical question, your AI assistant first confirms with you the subject (humans or which animal), the aspects to search (for example treatment effect, recurrence, prognosis, complications; up to 3 are included in the base price) and whether Factdock should translate the results or return the original English for the assistant to translate (cheaper). Each aspect is searched separately; every paper comes with sample size, study design, follow-up, key numbers quoted from the abstract, a DOI check and recalculated percentages. Numbers that are not in the abstract are never invented. **Statute search (`statute_search`):** the official, currently-in-force text of a law article with its effective date and the law's amendment history, from the government's own legislation database: Japan, the United Kingdom, the EU (every official EU language), Spain and Sweden live, and Factdock's copies of the official bulk data for France, Germany, the US Code of Federal Regulations and Canada. The provision text is never written by AI; a reference translation is returned next to the original. Other countries are not charged and get the link to the official database. **Medical and veterinary questions:** `academic_search` covers fields other than medicine and veterinary medicine (economics, engineering, law, environment and more) and does not search medical databases. For a medical or veterinary question use `medical_literature_search` (it asks for humans or which animal first); for drug labels and side effects use `medical_db_search` (literature takes `species`). ## Connect ### Claude Code ```bash claude mcp add --transport http factdock https://fact-dock.com/mcp ``` ### VS Code (GitHub Copilot) `.vscode/mcp.json`: ```json { "servers": { "factdock": { "type": "http", "url": "https://fact-dock.com/mcp" } } } ``` ### Cursor `~/.cursor/mcp.json`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "factdock": { "url": "https://fact-dock.com/mcp" } } } ``` ### Cline See [llms-install.md](llms-install.md). Cline settings (`cline_mcp_settings.json`): ```json { "mcpServers": { "factdock": { "type": "streamableHttp", "url": "https://fact-dock.com/mcp", "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer fdu_YOUR_KEY" } } } } ``` ### Antigravity CLI ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/factdock/factdock-mcp ``` The plugin asks for `FACTDOCK_API_KEY` (a personal API key from ). ### Gemini CLI ```bash gemini extensions install https://github.com/factdock/factdock-mcp ``` Sign in with your Factdock account when the browser opens. ### goose Settings → Extensions → Add custom extension → Remote extension (Streamable HTTP), URL `https://fact-dock.com/mcp`. ### Dify A Dify tool plugin is in [dify/factdock](dify/factdock). It connects to the Factdock Business API (`https://data.fact-dock.com`) with a Business API key and offers country web search, academic, patent, company, trade, infrastructure, finance and Insights tools. Two more Dify plugins use the product-specific keys: - [dify/factdock_insights](dify/factdock_insights): Insights news search and latest news, with an Insights API key. - [dify/factdock_medical](dify/factdock_medical): approved human and veterinary drugs, drug records, FDA adverse event report counts and medical literature, with a Medical DB API key. For professionals; not medical advice. ### Other MCP clients Any client that supports remote MCP servers over Streamable HTTP can use `https://fact-dock.com/mcp` with OAuth sign-in or a personal API key header. ## Personal API key Create a key on the API page of your Factdock account: . The key is shown once. You can set an expiry and revoke it at any time. ## Building Factdock into your own product The personal MCP server is for your own use and your own organization's internal work. To build Factdock search into a service for your customers, use the Factdock Business API: . ## Notes - Results cover published information only. An empty result means "not found or not covered", not "safe". - Factdock searches and shows published information for reference. It is not legal, medical, veterinary, financial or investment advice and does not replace a professional's judgement. Decisions should be made with a qualified professional, or by professionals using their own judgement. - Some tools (veterinary references and medicine databases) require you to accept their terms once in the Factdock app before they can be used through MCP. ## Links - Website: - Personal API and MCP: - Terms: - Privacy: - Contact: info@fact-dock.com The configuration files in this repository are released under the MIT License. The Factdock service itself is subject to the Factdock terms.
